description: This file provides extension methods for registering and configuring grain services within the Orleans framework, specifically for integrating grain services into the silo builder and service collection.

classes.name: GrainServicesSiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to register grain services into the Orleans silo builder and service collection.

methods.name: AddGrainService<T>(this ISiloBuilder builder)
methods.description: Registers a grain service implementation to be started with the silo, configuring the service collection accordingly.

methods.name: GrainServiceFactory(Type serviceType, IServiceProvider services)
methods.description: Creates an instance of the specified grain service type, ensuring it implements IGrainService, and assigns a grain ID.

methods.name: AddGrainService<T>(this IServiceCollection services)
methods.description: Registers a grain service implementation type as a singleton IGrainService in the service collection.

methods.name: AddGrainService(this IServiceCollection services, Type grainServiceType)
methods.description: Registers a grain service of specified type as a singleton IGrainService in the service collection.
